name: RecordGD
description: Automatically saves a video of your run when you beat a level.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Record every attempt and keep the video when you complete the level.

output-folder.name: Output Folder
output-folder.description: Where finished recordings are saved. Leave empty to use the mod's save folder (recordings/).

notify.name: Show Notifications
notify.description: Show a notification when a recording is being saved and when it's done.

ask-before-saving.name: Ask Before Saving
ask-before-saving.description: Show a 'Save Run' button on the end screen instead of saving every completion automatically. Runs you don't save are discarded when you leave the end screen.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: Output video height. Never upscales above your window size.

fps.name: FPS
fps.description: Frames per second of the saved video.

bitrate.name: Bitrate (Mbps)
bitrate.description: Video bitrate in megabits per second.

hardware-encoding.name: Hardware Encoding
hardware-encoding.description: Use your GPU's video encoder (NVIDIA / AMD / Intel) through Windows Media Foundation. Falls back to the built-in software encoder automatically if it fails.

audio.name: Record Audio
audio.description: Capture the game's audio (music and sound effects) at your current in-game volume.

pre-roll-seconds.name: Seconds Before Attempt
pre-roll-seconds.description: Also include this much footage from before the winning attempt started, for example your last death. 0 = the video starts with the winning attempt.

tail-seconds.name: Seconds After Completion
tail-seconds.description: Keep recording this long after you finish, to include the end animation.

microphone.name: Record Microphone
microphone.description: Mix your microphone into the video's audio. Off by default.

mic-volume.name: Microphone Volume
mic-volume.description: Microphone loudness in the video (1.0 = unchanged).

mic-device.name: Microphone Device
mic-device.description: 0 = system default input. 1, 2, 3... pick a specific device; the list is written to the Geode log when recording starts.

record-practice.name: Save Practice Runs
record-practice.description: Also save completions made in practice mode.

record-startpos.name: Save Start Position Runs
record-startpos.description: Also save completions that started from a start position.

first-completion-only.name: First Completion Only
first-completion-only.description: Only save a video the first time you beat a level.
